svg.title: Anatomy of a map
svg.desc: An event map of the Netherlands with numbered markers for each layout element: figure number, title, subtitle, key, map area, locator map, scale bar, source, note and logo.

text.style: font-family:IBM Plex Sans, Calibri, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.22em;fill:#191919;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#FFFFFF;stroke-width:3px;stroke-linejoin:round;

svg.text: Source: Fictional data, 2026 · Map: REN Data
Note: Each dot is one recorded event. Events within 2 km share a dot.
